OUR DIGITAL PALETTE

Grounded in green.
Brightened by gold.

Green builds recognition. Gold brings energy. Warm neutrals give content room. Click any swatch to copy its HEX value.

THE PRACTICAL DETAILS

Guidelines in practice

Proposed digital standards
01

Primary roles

Use brand green for brand surfaces and white text. Use gold as an accent with deep-green text.

02

Supporting roles

Use ink for body copy, cream for editorial surfaces and pale green for quiet grouping.

03

Source distinction

The canonical pair is proposed. Supplied logo artwork uses legacy colors and remains unchanged.
